title: Strabismus surgery
what: The surgeon loosens or tightens the muscles that move the eye, so the eyes look straight. The eyeball itself is not cut open.
why: For a squint that glasses and exercises do not correct, or to help the eyes work together again.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 90 minutes; you often go home the same day or the next
tell_doctor: All medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to do
Any problems with anesthesia in the patient or relatives
For a child: if they were ill in the past 2 weeks

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests and a checkup by a pediatrician or GP. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you or your child.

prepare.title: Food and drink
prepare.text: Usually no food or drink for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: For a child
prepare.text: If your child is having surgery, explain calmly that they will sleep, and you will be close by.

bring: Comfortable clothes, and a toy for a child
steps: You or your child change, and an IV line is placed
In the operating room, anesthesia is given, and the patient falls asleep
Through a small cut in the white of the eye, the surgeon moves the muscle
The patient wakes up in the recovery room
The doctor checks the eye and gives instructions
feel: The eye is red, watery, and feels gritty
Moving the eye hurts for the first days. You will get painkillers
after: Use eye drops exactly as prescribed
Do not rub the eye, and do not let a child rub it
No swimming in pools or open water for as long as your doctor says
Redness usually fades in a few weeks
Sometimes glasses or exercises are still needed after surgery
red_flags: Severe, growing pain, swelling, or pus from the eye
Trouble breathing, or the person will not wake up: call emergency services

faq.q: Will the eyes be straight right away?
faq.a: Often yes, but the final result is judged after a few weeks.
Sometimes. Your doctor will say based on the result.

faq.q: Do the stitches need to come out?
faq.a: Usually the stitches dissolve on their own.

reminders.text: Eye surgery tomorrow. Pack your documents and things. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
